text: I wouldn't trust that beast, if I was you. That thing is a killer.
source_text: I wouldn't trust that beast, if I was you. That thing is a killer.

text: 如果我是你的话我宁愿相信这个畜牲，那东西是个杀手。
source_text: 如果我是你的话我宁愿相信这个畜牲，那东西是个杀手。

text: I would be really happy if you were to get rid of that damn dog.
source_text: I would be really happy if you were to get rid of that damn dog.

text: 我真的会更高兴如果你能除掉那条该死的狗。
source_text: 我真的会更高兴如果你能除掉那条该死的狗。

text: Nah, I only deal with important stuff.
source_text: Nah, I only deal with important stuff.

text: 嗯，我只处理重要的事情。
source_text: 嗯，我只处理重要的事情。

text: Mebbe you can talk it to death.
source_text: Mebbe you can talk it to death.

text: It won't let us back into our house, that's why.
source_text: It won't let us back into our house, that's why.

text: 它不让我进屋，这就是原因。
source_text: 它不让我进屋，这就是原因。

text: It was the 'pet' of a traveler. When the traveler died, this damn dog just plopped its furry ass down on my doorstep and wouldn't leave. It's been there for days.
source_text: It was the 'pet' of a traveler. When the traveler died, this damn dog just plopped its furry ass down on my doorstep and wouldn't leave. It's been there for days.

text: 这是某个旅行者的“宠物”。当那个旅行者死了，这该死的狗就把它那毛毛的屁股杵在我家门口，再也不肯走了。这已经有段日子了。
source_text: 这是某个旅行者的“宠物”。当那个旅行者死了，这该死的狗就把它那毛毛的屁股杵在我家门口，再也不肯走了。这已经有段日子了。

text: What did the traveler look like?
source_text: What did the traveler look like?

text: 这个旅行者长什么样子？
source_text: 这个旅行者长什么样子？

text: I don't know. Some guy. He came from the east, he said. Like anyone could get past the deadlands to the east. He ran afoul of Gizmo, trying to interfere with Gizmo's business.
source_text: I don't know. Some guy. He came from the east, he said. Like anyone could get past the deadlands to the east. He ran afoul of Gizmo, trying to interfere with Gizmo's business.

text: 我不知道。他说他来自东边。就像任何能从东边穿过死亡陆地的人一样，他和吉斯莫起了点冲突，他想干涉吉斯莫的生意。
source_text: 我不知道。他说他来自东边。就像任何能从东边穿过死亡陆地的人一样，他和吉斯莫起了点冲突，他想干涉吉斯莫的生意。

text: So, Gizmo had a couple of boys beat him up and throw him from the casino roof. The traveler broke his damnfool neck and died. The dog was pissed.
source_text: So, Gizmo had a couple of boys beat him up and throw him from the casino roof. The traveler broke his damnfool neck and died. The dog was pissed.

text: 然后，吉斯莫的手下揍了他一顿，并把他扔到到赌场门口，可怜的旅行者折断了脖子死了。这条狗没主了。
source_text: 然后，吉斯莫的手下揍了他一顿，并把他扔到到赌场门口，可怜的旅行者折断了脖子死了。这条狗没主了。

text: What did the traveler look like?

text: Oh, the guy was tall, dark-haired with a little graying around the edges. He was dressed all in black leather, like that's a good idea in the desert, and carried a shotgun.

text: 噢，这家伙长得很高，黑头发，鬓角有些发白。他穿着一身黑色皮衣，在沙漠里挺实用的，他还带着把散弹枪。

text: He had some funny accent. The dog was his constant companion, followed him everywhere.
source_text: He had some funny accent. The dog was his constant companion, followed him everywhere.

text: 他带着很逗的口音，这条狗是他忠实的随从，到哪儿都跟着他。
